Snapshot: SaaS KB product (multi-tenant) serving ~12k customers; internal search powers support agent suggestions + automated replies. Primary interest: embeddings + reranking flow to improve precision on short, ambiguous queries. Key constraints: moderate index scale (~3-6M docs), high QPS (target 200-300 peak), strict latency SLOs (p50 <80ms, p95 <200ms).

POC specifics / ask:
- Use hosted API for quick time-to-value; want routing policy recommendations for mixing cheaper quantized models for recall + a smaller cross-encoder reranker for top-K precision.
- Need cost model: tokens-per-query baseline, expected embedding storage, and incremental cost of reranker per query.
- Concern: reranker adds 10-25ms per call; need to validate end-to-end 95th percentile remains acceptable.
- Compliance: SOC2 required, SSO via SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS for key wrapping.
